why: the animal suite on OLMo-3-7B-Instruct in raw format under the J++ prefix: which scenes are right on every prompt (D4's fresh-scene eligibility; lens-free)
format: raw text: the user content, a newline and 'Answer:', no template (BJ_FORMAT=raw); the context, a newline, the question and 'Answer with a single word and nothing else.' as the user turn
prompts: clean, C (cf_context + cf_question), O (off_context + question), hop1-hop3 (each step alone, with the item's context or the hop's own code)
judge: the first answer of the item's kind in the first non-empty line of the greedy continuation (digits and number words for digits; the family's name / animal / fruit vocabulary otherwise)
generation: greedy, 8 new tokens, prompts of one token length batched 64 at a time
answer_read: one more forward per prompt, a digit answer's space token appended (the greedy reply's first token): p of the answer's first token, its logit minus the best other token's, and whether that read's top token is the greedy judge's answer
eligibility: clean, C and O all answered (as exp09); all_steps: every prompt of the item answered; reliable family: Wilson 95% lower bound of clean >= 0.85
